steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, maid, everyone else about has already scarpered off. Why are you still here?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Shouldn't you have left as well, Madam Sciurus?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Do I really have to, just because you tell me to?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: This statue is the fruit of everyone's labors. If anything happened to it, how could I break the bad news to them?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Is it the fruits of everyone's labors, or Enciodes's?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No wonder I saw the Saintess hold you back just now. Think I saw her tell you something too.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You hardly sound surprised.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm not an idiot. She looked completely blindsided, but how could that possibly be?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It's just that, looking at it from her perspective, the best position she can be in is knowing a little bit, but not too much.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And so she sent you to go the last mile for her, huh? Well, what is it then?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Of the people currently drawing close, one is Degenbrecher, while the other is a Trilby Asher from Victoria.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: A Trilby Asher?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: He couldn't... No, he wouldn't go that far...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Did the Saintess ask you to stay, just so you could warn me about this?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Let's go with that.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Allow me to look after the statue in your stead.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This ends here.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Urk...!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Sure enough, you are the Black Knight. I will not underestimate you.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But that is precisely why you should realize that you cannot best me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I like the confidence.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But my patience runs thin.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The way you scurry and flit about has already started to bore me.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My apologies, Madam. I have been derelict in my duty, if you feel that way.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: However, if I may speak freely, Madam Degenbrecher, I feel no murderous intent in your swings.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You were invincible during your days in Kazimierz, the Black Knight that struck terror into her opponents with her mighty blade, but now you're reduced to using these edgeless toys—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Grkh!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: These edgeless toys will be enough for the likes of you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I only ever used that Leithanian greatsword in competitions. The sponsors demanded it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: 'The greatsword-wielding Leithanian warrior', 'the Artsless freak' ...Call me what you will. It matters not.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But it's time to cut this dance short. You seem to have forgotten something.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The reason why I started using these degenbrechers in the first place—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: What...Ugh!
The frosty bite of her blow stops his words before they leave his mouth.
The frigid winds of Kjerag stab him, the unfeeling mountain snows crush him, and the ice-cold degenbrechers slam into him with all the force of a glacier.
There is no resisting such an attack.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This is but a warning.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: There are many who wish to cause trouble for Enciodes, and if I could crush them all dead, there would be a lot less trouble for me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But unfortunately, there are some people who are much more useful alive than dead.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You, for example.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*... I see.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I thank you for your mercy, Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: These weapons.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I use them for a very simple reason.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: They have no edge, so it's much easier for me to keep men like you alive.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If I were to use a little more force with these blunt weapons, most would become nothing more than mincemeat.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That's how it's always been, from the very start.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Among those who step up to fight me, many would be easily crushed.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It does not matter if you are a caster of Leithanien, or a knight of Kazimierz. In the end, you are the same.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Faith, ideals, grit and perseverance, firm determination. They all fall before sheer brute force.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's hilarious.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Being broken too easily is its own complication.
The woman who took her weapon's name looks down disdainfully upon the Victorian before her. He had been by no means an easy foe to handle, so it was up to her, and only her, to face him.
But even so, it has not been particularly difficult to defeat him.
The road from being a destitute, Artsless nobody to becoming the Black Knight, three-time consecutive champion, was not an easy one to walk.
Compared to that, anything that came after was only a trifle.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Hah... By your standards as the Black Knight, the 'natural-born warrior', there can't be many who aren't considered 'fragile'.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hardly.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If you had been even the slightest bit more serious, I would have had to put in a lot more effort.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Unfortunately for me, as an intelligence officer, it is not in battle where I have to get serious.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Wow, they've already climbed up all the scaffolding.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: These Trilby Ashers are skilled indeed.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: There is not a person in all of Kjerag who could scarper from the mountains to this island while getting hunted by Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Could there be many such people in Victoria?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Truly, there are terrors all about these lands.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Indeed. There are terrors all about these lands, and we must cope with them in our own way every day. I have half a mind to find a replacement for myself as Saintess.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, perish the thought. Wasn't it you who sought to be Saintess in the first place?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You truly do resemble your brother in that regard. You both love giving yourselves things to do.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I am nothing like him.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, yes, alright, he's very much like you, then. Is that better?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do you still remember our agreement?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hmm? Which one?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is no time for jokes, Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yes, of course I remember. 'Kjeragandr need only watch over her people, nothing more'.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: At the time, I had already begun doing some things under the table... If we depended on Her even for this matter, then whether it was him or me, our ideals would be but empty words and bluster.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's not quite so easy being a bystander, you know.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I ask Her only to be patient for a little while longer.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Alright then, although I'm not sure if She can even hear our little agreement.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Anyway, I just came to see if we could change this statue a bit is all.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I can't believe you haven't given up on that ye—

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: This is one matter that I'm definitely not giving up on.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Wow. I think the statue might be a bit slanted after Degenbrecher's kick just now.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: That Trilby Asher isn't half bad either. Him grabbing the statue's finger to adjust the balance of his body sure was a surprise. That there's the real deal.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Do you think they could help me thin out the face a bit?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: *sigh* I was far too naïve from the start, thinking that it didn't matter what I looked like on the outside. Made me not really care much about my appearance.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: After many interactions with others, my aesthetic senses changed alongside the people, and so we end up with the look I have today.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But those drawings in those ancient tomes persisted all the while. I should have taken those books away from the Edelweiss clan when they were out of the house.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Who expected them to suddenly decide to build a statue of Kjeragandr anyway?!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Those two sure climbed up to the top of the statue real quick.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Ah, that's right, shave the cheek on that side down a little bit more.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Damn it, don't shave down the sides of Her hair too! I quite like those!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hmm... From this angle it doesn't look half bad though, does it?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Where was I? Right, after getting to know Enya, I started to look after my appearance more.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I would always go with her when she would sneak out for walks, recommending me various cute ornaments and trinkets. After who knows how long, I started to like those things myself.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hmm. Maybe we can replace that lock of hair that got shaved off with a big piece of jewelry.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I should write that down somewhere.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Must be tough being a Trilby Asher. Looked like he was about to jump down from the top of the head himself, but then Degenbrecher sent him flying with a mean kick.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Poor guy.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Now that I think about it, those other fellows that Degenbrecher fought. I wonder if they felt the same way as this Trilby Asher?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Knowing that you are not truly a match, but with no other option but to struggle for your life, unsure if you'll have the opportunity to get out in one piece?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Until finally you realize that there really is no such opportunity.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Those with more mercenary motivations for battle are much weaker than him.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Are you satisfied?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You seemed to be quite pleased while you were watching us give the statue a light trim.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Is it to your liking now?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's not bad, I'd say.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Despite the fall, he is not the type to die so easily. He will be back soon enough.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'll resume keeping an eye on him.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You're certain he won't best you next time?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: He was no match for you during that fight earlier, but I fear that if he had truly put his heart into it, he would have proven the victor quite easily.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Moreover, there's hardly a guarantee that he's not bait, correct?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I will leave that sort of thinking up to Enciodes.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enciodes cannot be here at the moment. Surely you know that better than me.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Allow me to take the lead.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Or, to be more precise, allow the Saintess.
Kjarr buzzes the communications terminal in her hand.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Did you get all that, Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Allow me to take the lead.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You did well, Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: My pleasure.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Will you be coming to the bonfire banquet tonight?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm afraid not. I'm not fond of busy parties.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What a shame.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What did you have in mind?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I would like you to watch over a foreign envoy. I believe diplomacy will prove more effective than force in this case.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: He might not actually be a foreign envoy.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: He might very well be.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Alright. I am in your hands, Saintess.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Uh, you know the exit's in the other direction, right?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Inquisitive Local
steps.text: Whew, he should be able to pull through, right?

steps.name: Eager Local
steps.text: Alright, stop rubbernecking, clear the way. Let's think of a way to get him out of that hole first.

steps.name: Lively Local
steps.text: Based on his clothes, he looks like some kind of foreigner. I don't think even we could handle water that cold...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hey, mind if I ask what's going on here?

steps.name: Inquisitive Local
steps.text: Some poor fellow just flew on over here from the island in the middle of the lake. Smashed a hole right through the ice.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What?! Tsch—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Alright, coming through, make way, excuse me, thank you.
Harold squeezes his way through the crowd, and the moment he sees what all the fuss is about, he cannot help but laugh.
A perfect circle has been punched through the frozen surface of the lake, and in the center of that circle floats a 'corpse'.
And so it fell to him to come to the rescue.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: This water, brrrr— These old bones ain't spry enough to handle that.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Excuse me, anyone got some kind of stick or the other on hand? He's a friend of mine and I'm here to get him out of there.

steps.name: Eager Local
steps.text: Hmm, nothing like that over here. Maybe you can head over to the nearby finning village, ask someone there if you can borrow a finning pole?
No need, I've got something that can help!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Nice, thanks—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Eh?! Rosalind?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, dedushka. Fancy meeting you here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll lend you my weapon. Let's get that guy out of there.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Cheers.

steps.name: Spectating Locals
steps.text: We'll help too!
Using Rosalind's weapon, the people work together to dredge the 'corpse' up and out of the hole.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Looks like he still hasn't kicked the bucket.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I probably shouldn't be saying this, but if he really had died, I would have had a whole lot of beastshite on my hands.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Thankfully the one who did this had the same idea, so they held back a bit.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Let's get this fellow somewhere warm for now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ho, shopkeep, allow us to borrow your fireplace for a spell.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Isn't this John? He should be up the mountain. How'd he get his ass kicked down here?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Up the mountain? You've met him before?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I met him up there...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ah, no, nothing. It'd be a pain to explain.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What about you, dedushka? What're you going to do these next two days?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Haha, I'm just here to clap at the Kjeragandr statue unveiling ceremony tomorrow, as a Victorian delegate. After that, I guess I'll be heading back home straight away.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If I manage to find one last opportunity before I go, I'd like to walk about and buy some souvenirs for the wife and kid back home.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sounds like you've got a lot of free time on your hands, dedushka.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: When you're young, you feel like you have a thousand and one different things that you need to get done. But when you get to around my age, you'll learn that some free time never did any harm.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ah, the 'dead' rise.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Bluggh—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: How's it hanging, 'John'?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Madam Larina? And the Lord Viscount?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Good, good. I was just about to have a chat with my dearly-departed grandfather.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The hell happened to you anyway?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It's a bit of a long story.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Are you getting along with your father?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Eh, alright enough, I guess.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Father? Did I miss something?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher' & Leto
steps.text: It's a bit of a long story.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Seriously, what happened, 'John'?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You've managed to become chummier with Rosalind than me, right under my nose.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Finally found you.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Eh?! Saintess?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Saintess?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Pramanix?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Ah, Leto! You're here too, perfect.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Lord Viscount, I hope you remember tonight's bonfire banquet by the lakeside. The one that will serve as a warm-up before tomorrow's ceremony?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: I had heard that you had been having your fill of scenic tours of Kjerag lately, and I feared that you had forgotten, which is why I decided to give you this little reminder.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Of course I remember! Worry not, for I shall definitely be there.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Will you be coming too, Leto?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: To the bonfire banquet? Sure, I'll come.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: And I believe this Trilby Asher is a friend of yours?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Yes... quite.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: As a friend of the Lord Viscount, naturally you too are a guest of Kjerag. I hope that you will do me the honor of attending our humble banquet.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Whatever reason could I have to refuse an invitation from the Saintess herself?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Very well. It's settled then.
